resources.string: Silent, looping video on your screen
No videos yet. Tap "Import video" or "Import ZIP".
Could not import this video. It may be too large or not playable on this phone.
Delete this video from the app?
Lock screen: Android lets apps set only a still frame there on most phones. Live video on the lock screen depends on your phone brand.
Video updated. It plays wherever Live Video Wallpaper is already set.
Success: Live Video Wallpaper is active.
Not applied. You cancelled, or this phone blocked it. Try again, or use Settings > Wallpaper > Live wallpapers.
This phone has no live wallpaper chooser. Open Settings > Wallpaper and choose Live Video Wallpaper.
Lock screen set to a still frame from this video.
Could not set the lock screen on this phone.
This phone does not allow apps to change the wallpaper.
Pick a ZIP file that contains videos (MP4, M4V, 3GP, WebM, MKV). Videos can be in any folder inside the ZIP. Nothing in the ZIP is ever executed.
Pause video in Battery Saver mode

Video wallpapers use more battery than still ones. The video pauses automatically when the screen is off or covered by an app. If your phone stops the wallpaper in the background, set battery usage for this app to Unrestricted.
Delete every imported video and reset the wallpaper?
Videos always play without sound. Lock-screen live wallpaper support differs by Android version and phone brand, so this app cannot force it everywhere.
